spec.label: SYNTHETIC — planning simulation, not evidence about any project or developer
spec.model: Per departure d: m units the leaver owned at t (blame at t), loss prevalence pi_d ~ Beta(mean 0.3, a+b = 10), latent loss z_i ~ Bernoulli(pi_d). Pre-t expected outcome events per unit per window mu_i = floor * (1 + Exp(1)), so every unit meets the activity floor. Between-unit heterogeneity is persistent and cancels in the unit's own post/pre ratio, so only period-to-period noise is simulated: Y_pre ~ NB(mu_i, size_t), Y_post ~ NB(mu_i * RR^z_i, size_t), Poisson when size_t is None. The departure-level change in activity is assumed removed exactly by the control units of the difference-in-differences. Observed label L_i = 1 if (Y_post + 0.5) / (Y_pre + 0.5) > sqrt(2), the geometric midpoint of 1 and RR. Scores: baseline = a_b z + e_b, map = a_m z + e_m, corr(e_b, e_m) = 0.5, a = sqrt(2) * Phi^-1(latent AUROC). Null: map latent AUROC = baseline's (0.62). Alternative: map latent AUROC = 0.82. Statistic: pooled within-departure Mann-Whitney dAUROC = sum_d sum_pairs (psi_map - psi_base) / sum_d pairs, ties 1/2, with a departure-cluster ratio-estimator variance. Stop if dAUROC + z_stop * SE < delta; Continue if dAUROC - z_continue * SE > 0 and dAUROC >= delta; otherwise inconclusive.

selfcheck.best_reachable_note: an oracle map knows z, not the observed label, so its observed dAUROC is bounded by label noise; see label_reliability
